title: The actual pro-etale proper/open tower operations and canonical composition
statement: For a commutative coefficient ring $\Lambda$, define $P_t=Rt_{p,*}$ as ordinary derived direct image, $J_v=v_{p,!}$ as exact pro-etale open extension by zero, and $v_p^*$ as exact derived restriction [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations, def-weil-extension-by-zero]. For a commuting square $bp=ri$ define $\operatorname{Ex}:i_p^*P_p\to P_rb_p^*$ by the actual unit for $r$, commuting pullback comparison, and counit for $p$ [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange]. For open $b$ the open unit $\eta_b:1\simeq b_p^*J_b$ gives $\lambda_N=\operatorname{Ex}_{J_bN};P_r(\eta_{b,N}^{-1})$. Given its invertibility and open $i$, define $\gamma_N$ as the inverse image of $\lambda_N^{-1}$ under the open adjunction Hom equivalence. Define $J_bJ_j\simeq J_{jb}$ by uniqueness of the left adjoint to composite open restriction [lem-weil-extension-by-zero-adjunction], and transport along equality of open maps to obtain $J_{jb}\simeq J_a$. For finite $\Lambda$ and compatible compactifications $d$ of $f:V\to W$ and $e$ of $h d.i:U\to d.Z$, define $\operatorname{towerOriginComposition}$ by conjugating the specified $\operatorname{originCompositionAmbient}$ of [thm-sf-comp-composition] to the candidates $e.\mathrm{restrict},d,d.\mathrm{comp}(e)$ via [def-sf-origin-candidate-comparison]. These are concrete constructions, with no assertion of invertibility for $\gamma$ or normalization of composition.
